import MumfordLib.SimplicialCupProduct
import MumfordLib.SingularCupFaces
import MumfordLib.CupSignedSum

/-!
# The signed differential identity for simplicial cups

Splitting the face sum at the shared vertex of the Alexander--Whitney product
gives its signed Leibniz rule. In particular, multiplying by a closed cochain
commutes with the differential up to the sign of its degree.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Opposite AlgebraicTopology
open scoped Simplicial

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {K : SSet} {p q n m : ℕ}

private def simplicialRestrictedEval (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K p)
    (σ : K.obj (op ⦋n⦌)) (f : ⦋p⦌ ⟶ ⦋n⦌) : ℤ :=
  simplicialCochainEval φ (K.map f.op σ)

private theorem simplicialRestrictedEval_comp (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K p)
    (σ : K.obj (op ⦋n⦌)) (f : ⦋p⦌ ⟶ ⦋m⦌) (g : ⦋m⦌ ⟶ ⦋n⦌) :
    simplicialRestrictedEval φ (K.map g.op σ) f =
      simplicialRestrictedEval φ σ (f ≫ g) := by
  simp only [simplicialRestrictedEval, op_comp, Functor.map_comp_apply]

private theorem simplicialRestrictedEval_differential (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K p)
    (σ : K.obj (op ⦋n⦌)) (f : ⦋p + 1⦌ ⟶ ⦋n⦌) :
    simplicialRestrictedEval (simplicialCochainDifferential K p φ) σ f =
      ∑ i : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ i.val *
        simplicialRestrictedEval φ σ (SimplexCategory.δ i ≫ f) := by
  unfold simplicialRestrictedEval
  rw [simplicialCochainDifferential_eval]
  simp only [SimplicialObject.δ, op_comp, Functor.map_comp_apply]

private theorem simplicialCochainCup_face_eval (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K p)
    (ψ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K q) (h : p + q = n)
    (σ : K.obj (op ⦋n + 1⦌)) (i : Fin (n + 2)) :
    simplicialCochainEval (simplicialCochainCup φ ψ h) (K.δ i σ) =
      simplicialRestrictedEval φ σ
        (SimplexCategory.subinterval 0 p (by omega) ≫ SimplexCategory.δ i) *
      simplicialRestrictedEval ψ σ
        (SimplexCategory.subinterval p q (by omega) ≫ SimplexCategory.δ i) := by
  rw [simplicialCochainCup_eval]
  exact congrArg₂ (· * ·)
    (simplicialRestrictedEval_comp φ σ _ _) (simplicialRestrictedEval_comp ψ σ _ _)

/-- The Alexander--Whitney cup satisfies the signed Leibniz identity in every
bidegree, including degree zero. -/
theorem simplicialCochainCup_differential (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K p)
    (ψ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K q) (h : p + q = n) :
    simplicialCochainDifferential K n (simplicialCochainCup φ ψ h) =
      simplicialCochainCup (simplicialCochainDifferential K p φ) ψ (by omega) +
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ p •
          simplicialCochainCup φ (simplicialCochainDifferential K q ψ) (by omega) := by
  apply integralSimplicialCochain_ext
  intro σ
  let a : Fin (p + 2) → ℤ := fun i => simplicialRestrictedEval φ σ
    (SimplexCategory.δ i ≫ SimplexCategory.subinterval 0 (p + 1) (by omega))
  let b : Fin (q + 2) → ℤ := fun i => simplicialRestrictedEval ψ σ
    (SimplexCategory.δ i ≫ SimplexCategory.subinterval p (q + 1) (by omega))
  let c : Fin (n + 2) → ℤ := fun i =>
    simplicialRestrictedEval φ σ
      (SimplexCategory.subinterval 0 p (by omega) ≫ SimplexCategory.δ i) *
    simplicialRestrictedEval ψ σ
      (SimplexCategory.subinterval p q (by omega) ≫ SimplexCategory.δ i)
  let A := simplicialRestrictedEval φ σ (SimplexCategory.subinterval 0 p (by omega))
  let B := simplicialRestrictedEval ψ σ (SimplexCategory.subinterval (p + 1) q (by omega))
  have hleft (i : Fin (n + 2)) (hi : i.val ≤ p) :
      c i = a ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ * B := by
    dsimp only [c, a, B]
    rw [subinterval_comp_face_inside (by omega) i (by omega) (by omega),
      subinterval_comp_face_before (by omega) i hi]
    simp only [Nat.sub_zero]
  have hright (i : Fin (n + 2)) (hi : p < i.val) :
      c i = A * b ⟨i.val - p, by omega⟩ := by
    dsimp only [c, A, b]
    rw [subinterval_comp_face_after (by omega) i (by omega),
      subinterval_comp_face_inside (by omega) i (by omega) (by omega)]
  have ha : a (Fin.last (p + 1)) = A := by
    dsimp only [a, A]
    rw [face_last_comp_subinterval]
  have hb : b 0 = B := by
    dsimp only [b, B]
    rw [face_zero_comp_subinterval]
  calc
    _ = ∑ i : Fin (n + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ i.val * c i := by
      rw [simplicialCochainDifferential_eval]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i _
      rw [simplicialCochainCup_face_eval]
    _ = (∑ i : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ i.val * a i) * B +
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ p * A * (∑ i : Fin (q + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ i.val * b i) :=
      singularCup_signed_sum h a b c A B hleft hright ha hb
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [simplicialCochainEval_add, simplicialCochainEval_smul]
      rw [simplicialCochainCup_eval, simplicialCochainCup_eval]
      change _ = simplicialRestrictedEval (simplicialCochainDifferential K p φ) σ
        (SimplexCategory.subinterval 0 (p + 1) (by omega)) * B +
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ p * (A * simplicialRestrictedEval (simplicialCochainDifferential K q ψ) σ
          (SimplexCategory.subinterval p (q + 1) (by omega)))
      rw [simplicialRestrictedEval_differential, simplicialRestrictedEval_differential]
      change _ = (∑ i : Fin (p + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ i.val * a i) * B +
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ p * (A * (∑ i : Fin (q + 2), (-1 : ℤ) ^ i.val * b i))
      ring

/-- Multiplication on the left by a cocycle commutes with the differential
up to the sign of its degree. -/
theorem simplicialCochainCup_differential_of_left_cocycle
    (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K p) (ψ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K q)
    (hφ : simplicialCochainDifferential K p φ = 0) (h : p + q = n) :
    simplicialCochainDifferential K n (simplicialCochainCup φ ψ h) =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ p •
        simplicialCochainCup φ (simplicialCochainDifferential K q ψ) (by omega) := by
  rw [simplicialCochainCup_differential, hφ]
  simp

/-- A product of two closed simplicial cochains is closed. -/
theorem simplicialCochainCup_cocycle
    (φ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K p) (ψ : IntegralSimplicialCochain K q)
    (hφ : simplicialCochainDifferential K p φ = 0)
    (hψ : simplicialCochainDifferential K q ψ = 0) (h : p + q = n) :
    simplicialCochainDifferential K n (simplicialCochainCup φ ψ h) = 0 := by
  rw [simplicialCochainCup_differential_of_left_cocycle φ ψ hφ h, hψ]
  simp

end Mumford.Analytic
